# FG-GIT-0013

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 413 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `gzip_bomb_stops_at_cap` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: Git の要求が大きすぎます。
- en: The Git request is too large.
- id: Permintaan Git terlalu besar.

## 原因 (cause)

A Smart HTTP request body went over a forge limit: the decompressed size of a gzip request body (`Content-Encoding: gzip`), or a body or command-list limit of the route. Decoding stops at the limit, so a compressed bomb never expands past it.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `limit` (which limit, e.g. `gzip_decompressed`), `max_bytes` and the route context (`service`). A legitimate client hitting it usually means a fetch negotiation with very many haves/wants (huge ref counts) or a push over the push size limit.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing to fix for a hostile or broken client. For a legitimate one, check the repository's ref count; raise the limit (configuration `git.http.*`, M1 phase 9 MR3/MR4) only with that evidence.
